fusions.name: Mouldering Touch
fusions.desc: A touch that deals 10 poison damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Squeezed Puffball
fusions.desc: Squeezes a puffball in your fist, dealing 7 poison damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long, with a 40% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Pressed into Loam
fusions.desc: You press a handful of spores into the ground: a ring of mushrooms stands for 15 seconds and deals 2 poison damage every second to an enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Overnight Growth
fusions.desc: Every hit you land plants a stack on the target, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
